capabilities: Toggle wrap text on Bases table views via a ribbon icon
Cycle between medium, tall, and extra row-height levels
Expose wrap toggle and row-height commands in the command palette
Restore compact row height when the plugin is disabled
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.9.0 or later, since the Bases core plugin was introduced in that version.
intentEvidence: changes the rowHeight view setting in the current .base file. Bases natively supports short / medium / tall / extra row heights
problem: Bases table views truncate long cell content to a single line, making wide text hard to read.
summary: Bases table add-on that adds an Excel-style wrap-text toggle, so long cell content wraps to multiple lines instead of being truncated.
